Hi! Welcome to Fox's website—thanks for stopping by. I go to Pomona College and use he/him pronouns. You may catch me playing Spikeball, knocking out a problem set, or working on an oil painting. Let's go Brooklyn Nets!

Feel free to check out examples of my work on the tabs above: emphasis on cities and transportation.
